The till side is done; the root fix needs giftCards/service.ts, which is not in my file list. applyGiftCardTender now runs the redeem, the bill change and applyCoverageTx in ONE transaction under lockOrderTx whenever giftCards/service.js exports redeemGiftCardTx(tx, input). Until then it falls back to the old unlocked path, so production still has the race. Done in the interrupted pass, which I reviewed. voidOrderItem, under the order lock: if what is paid still fits the bill without the line, it lowers the bill. If the order is fully paid but still open, it voids the line and refunds removedCents on the latest tender that can cover it, through the shared writeRefundTx (a refund row plus postRefundPayment in the same transaction). A cash refund needs the refunder's open drawer of the order's company. The last line gives VOID_LAST_LINE (cancel instead). Part-paid with payments above the reduced bill still gives ORDER_PARTLY_PAID. Tests: auditTillReview R3 (5 cases, including company B getting 404).

prodNotes: No schema change and no migration. Deploy the API and the admin together. The new admin close flow uses GET /pos/shifts/:id/open-tickets and confirmOpenTickets, and the API's OPEN_TICKETS 409 has no client that sends confirmOpenTickets other than this admin. On an old admin a drawer with an unpaid ticket cannot be closed (the original TILL-R1 symptom). TILL-R2 stays open in production until giftCards/service.ts exports redeemGiftCardTx (needsOtherFiles 1). Until then a gift card redeemed at the same moment as a cash or card tender on the same bill can still charge the guest twice. If it happens, the fix is a refund and a card re-credit. The tablet printer change is source only; it reaches devices with the next tablet build. receipt-data has no duplicate flag, so the tablet must call printReceipt(orderId, { duplicate: true }) for reprints. Existing tipped refunds already filed with SRB over-claimed GST on the tip (about tip×rate/(1+rate) each) and are not corrected retroactively. If any exist, the accountant should review the SRB sales-returns for refunded orders with tipCents > 0.
